<!-- pr-reviewer: e24f6bacfe9ea50ee11c04a98c540c08f8985b5b -->
**Verdict: needs changes before merge** — one mechanical body fix. No code findings. The tree is MERGEABLE and the build is green.

What looks good:
- The fix removes the two fixed paths (`rough-only` and `right-only`) in the system temp folder. Both posts now target a `tempfile::tempdir()` folder, kept alive for the scope of the test. The tempdir binding holds the folder until end of test.
- The pattern matches line 337 of the same file.
- Nothing changed under test. No golden changed. No dependency added: `tempfile` was already a dev-dependency.
- The trial merge with current `origin/main` (c79c9b24f) is clean. `MERGEABLE`, `CLEAN` at the head.

Results (local build, trial-merged worktree, -j 6, sccache):
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test wire_post`: 37 passed, 0 failed (24.2 s). Both pinning tests pass: `an_open_run_with_a_skim_generates_verifies_and_posts` and `a_centre_slit_with_a_skim_generates_verifies_and_posts`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean (0 warnings).

Targeted tests:
- No post or toolpath change. No example catalog run.
- Light lane not run: no code under test changed (same as the PR body). Not a pass.
- No heavy step: this is a test-only PR. No wrong-output path. No heavy finding.
- `<!-- heavy-wave: ... -->` record: none. Absence is not a finding.

Requested before merge (numbered, one finding):
1. The body must end with `Fixes #4405` to close the issue this PR addresses. The body ends with `Refs #4400` for the rolling red issue. Fix is one line, mechanical, body-only. Keep `Refs #4400` for the rolling red issue (this PR does not fix it).

Questions / notes (not blocking):
- The linked issue #4405 and the PR carry the `P1` label. A test-path fix on a shared runner is a nuisance, not wrong output. Consider the priority label.
- PR #4400 (the rolling red post-merge gate) is not fixed by this PR. The body says so. Correct as written.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
